headline: Executive order concerning the North Pacific Anadromous Fish Commission, an international body dealing with ocean-migrating fish like salmon.
what_it_does: This order relates to the North Pacific Anadromous Fish Commission. Anadromous fish, such as salmon, are born in rivers, live in the ocean, and return to rivers to spawn. Orders like this one usually give an international group certain legal protections and privileges in the United States. No summary was provided, so the exact details are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: North Pacific Anadromous Fish Commission and its staff
who_it_affects.how: The order likely sets out how the commission is legally treated while operating in the United States.
